title: Supply of Geyser, Refrigerator, Air Conditioner and Washing Machine at various Lighthouse under Kolkata Directorate
summary: GeM two-packet bid for supply, installation, testing and commissioning of geysers, refrigerators, split air conditioners and washing machines at six lighthouse/DGPS/NAVTEX stations under the Kolkata Directorate.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Kolkata

sites.name: Sagar Island LH & DGPS Station
sites.work: Supply of 1 geyser and 1 washing machine

sites.name: Paradip LH & DGPS Station
sites.work: Supply of 1 geyser, 1 washing machine, 1 refrigerator and 1 air conditioner

sites.name: Kalingapatnam LH
sites.work: Supply of 1 air conditioner and 1 washing machine

scope.item: Electric water heater (geyser), closed type, 10 litre, BEE 4 star, wall mount, with installation
Split air conditioner, wall mount, 5 star, inverter, with standard installation
Domestic washing machine, fully automatic, 8 kg

money.notes: EMD Rs 18,300 (advisory bank SBI; beneficiary Director of Lighthouses and Lightships, Kolkata); ATC allows DD/FDR/BG or bid security declaration for MSME bidders. MII purchase preference L1+20% up to 50% of quantity (Class 1/Class 2 local suppliers only); MSE purchase preference L1+15% up to 25%.

period.warranty: 1 year from final acceptance/installation (refrigerator compressor 10 years; washing machine motor 10 years)

eligibility: GeM: bidder minimum average annual turnover Rs 2 lakh (3 years); OEM average turnover Rs 24 lakh; 3 years past experience; past performance 30% of bid quantity; MSE and startup relaxation

ATC mandatory: EMD or bid security declaration, PAN, GST, authorized dealership/distributor/OEM/reseller certificate for geyser, refrigerator, AC and washing machine, non-blacklisting affidavit (2026), ITRs 2023-24 to 2025-26, unconditional price bid undertaking, bid acceptance letter, technical compliance sheet

ATC scoring: average annual turnover >= 30% of estimated cost (16 marks), solvency >= 40% of estimated cost (4), similar works in last 7 years - three >= 40%, two >= 50% or one >= 80% of estimated cost (30), time over-run performance (20), quality performance (30); minimum total 60 and minimum in each head

Bidder/OEM must have functional service centre in each consignee state (carry-in warranty), dedicated/toll-free service number and escalation matrix; offered products to have at least 5 years residual market life
specs: Geyser: IS 2082, closed type, 10 litre, BEE 4 star, wall mount
Refrigerator: IS 17550, frost-free, double door, BEE 3 star or higher, 1 year product warranty, 10 year compressor warranty; GeM volume 301-350 L vs ATC 261-300 L with 3 shelves
Split AC: IS 1391 (Part 2), inverter, cooling only, BEE 5 star; GeM capacity 1.3-1.7 ton vs ATC 1.5-1.7 ton; ODU wall stand, drain pipe and IDU-ODU cable included
Washing machine: fully automatic front-load, 8 kg, water heating, toughened glass lid, stainless steel cabinet and drum, digital touch panel, Wi-Fi IoT, 10 year motor warranty
Minimum local content 50% (Class 1) / 20% (Class 2); BIS mark required
Scope of supply: supply, installation, testing and commissioning; option clause +/-25% quantity
notes: Pages 1-13 GeM bid document (text layer); pages 14-25 scanned buyer ATC dated 28.07.2026, compliance sheet, quantity sheet, delivery addresses and annexures (read by vision). GeM marked as short duration bid for emergency procurement. ATC copy-paste errors: similar works defined as 'Supply and installation of batteries' and EMD exemption refers to 'category of battery'.
